description: This file defines a Spring framework condition class `FineractPartitionJobConfigValidationCondition` that checks configuration properties related to partitioned jobs in the Fineract project. It validates that certain thread pool and partition size parameters meet specific criteria and logs errors if invalid configurations are found.

classes.name: FineractPartitionJobConfigValidationCondition
classes.description: A Spring Condition class that validates the configuration of partitioned jobs to ensure parameters are correctly set.

methods.name: matches
methods.description: Determines if the current context has invalid partitioned job configurations based on specified criteria.

methods.name: isAnyConfigBelowOne
methods.description: Returns a predicate that checks if any partitioned job configuration parameter is less than or equal to zero.

methods.name: invalidMaxPoolSize
methods.description: Checks if the thread pool max size is smaller than the core pool size, which is invalid.
